title: Move the Wall In
setup: The rook already forbids the b-file, so the lone king's whole world is a8 and a7. Two of White's moves throw the win away.
hint: The rook cannot take both of the black king's squares by itself — who else is near enough, and which square keeps the cut alive?
explanation:
## The Idea

The wall is already up: while the rook holds the b-file the bare king can never cross it. What is missing is the second piece, because the rook cannot cover a7 and a8 as well.

{{Kc7}} takes b8, b7 and b6. Black has one legal move, {{Ka7}}, and {{Ra1#}} swings the wall onto the king's file — check from one end, no square at the other.

The two ways to throw it away: {{Rb7}} covers both squares and is stalemate, and {{Rb8+}} simply hands the rook to the king.
